wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
During the round whenever a WILD symbol of any size hits, it gets a random multiplier of 1x, 2x or 3x and it remains
 on the reels until the end of the round, changing size as reel size changes in subsequent spins.
 Until the end of the round each reel size is guaranteed to be at minimum the size of the
 number of WILDS symbols sticky on it.
 The feature can not be retriggered.
 Special reels are in play during FREE SPINS feature.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS ROUND along with the FREE SPINS options can be instantly triggered from the base
 game by buying it for 100x current total bet. On any buy a random number of SCATTER symbols,
 from 3 to 6 can hit to trigger the feature.
